import os,glob,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
print(json.dumps(G.get('Test input')))
print(G.get('Demo pair 1 input'))
print(G.get('Demo pair 1 output'))

import json
def f(g):
    import numpy as np
    m=g.copy(); colors=[c for r in m for c in r]
    val=sorted(set(colors))[-1]
    vals=set(colors); mask=[c==val for c in colors]
    pts=[(i//len(r),i%len(r)) for i,mk in enumerate(mask) if mk]
    r0,r1=min(p[0] for p in pts),max(p[0] for p in pts)
    c0,c1=min(p[1] for p in pts),max(p[1] for p in pts)
    h=r1-r0+1; w=c1-c0+1
    S=[[g[r0+i][c0+j] for j in range(w)] for i in range(h)]
    return [[S[i][j] for j in range(w)]+[S[i][j] for j in range(w)] for i in range(h)]
out=f(G['Test input'])
print(json.dumps(out))
assert f(G['Demo pair 1 input'])==G['Demo pair 1 output']
